headline: Teachers push back on 'adoption before safety'
digest: The Canadian Teachers' Federation warned the National AI Literacy Initiative asks teachers to adopt AI before its learning safety is known, with no impact-measurement plan. Glasgow's Lovelace–Hodgkin Symposium explored missing data, power and participation through art and games. SRI affiliates joined a 400-academic call for AI cybersecurity safeguards and launched culturally grounded mental-health AI research.
